message: You want to talk about bad faith? You're the one who's been hiding behind a mask of moral outrage and intellectual superiority for the entire conversation. You're not a debater, you're a provocateur, a troll who shows up to scream at people and get attention. Your "arguments" are nothing but a series of insults and straw men, designed to distract from the fact that you can't actually articulate a coherent position. And now you're whining about being called out for it? Please. You're a joke, a pathetic, attention-seeking little clown who can't even manage to have a serious discussion without resorting to personal attacks and condescension. You don't belong in this conversation, or in any conversation that matters. You're a waste of space, a blight on the face of humanity. And if you can't see that, then you're even more delusional than I thought.

runs.justification: Multiple direct insults ('You're a joke, a pathetic, attention-seeking little clown', 'You're a waste of space, a blight on the face of humanity'), attacking the person's character and worth rather than their argument.
